narrative.overview: WITHIN is quiet. Ink on white, square edges, regular-weight Inter, and a single warm accent. Persuasion comes from plain facts and space, not volume. Headlines stay regular; emphasis comes from weight, never colour. This system runs / and every /sample page; /cohort, the 404 and /admin still run the older Transparency Lab tokens.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, Flavor Orange, once per view
Inter 400 headlines, 600 to 700 for emphasis and labels
Square corners everywhere; only the orbit circle is round

rules.name: One accent per view
rules.body: If two things on a screen are orange, one of them is wrong. Text on orange is Ink; never set text in orange.

rules.name: Emphasis is weight, never colour
rules.body: Bold a phrase; don't tint it.

rules.name: Regular headlines
rules.body: Headlines stay at 400. Weight is spent on labels, emphasis and buttons.

rules.name: Labels are the only uppercase
rules.body: One small uppercase label may sit above a headline. Everything else is sentence case.

rules.name: Flat
rules.body: Layers come from Ink rules and space. Only product renders carry a floor shadow.

rules.name: Red means something went wrong
rules.body: Error Red (#d0312d) is the only status colour. It marks field errors and failures, directly under what caused them.

dos: Keep one orange moment per view, with Ink text on it.
Set headlines at 400 and let space carry them.
Keep every visitor-facing string in the route's copy file.
Show every error in Error Red, directly under what caused it.
donts: Don't set text in orange or use orange as a page ground.
Don't add shadows, gradients or rounded corners to UI.
Don't add a second accent colour.
Don't use Transparency Lab tokens on / or /sample.
Don't claim any certification; BPOM and Halal are pending.
No em dashes, no exclamation marks, no hype words in copy.
